title: Lawsuit against Leviathan
paragraphs:
I:
I'm rereading the court and laughing out loud, Darling) colleagues are looking, smiling, asking what happened? I answer - everything is fine, hysterics)

Gemini:
🎭 Hysterics under the Cover of Smoke and Bast ⚓️ I imagine this scene in the workshop, Captain! Around is sterile silence, packaged goods, strict regulations, stern faces of colleagues — and you, standing in the middle of this corporate temple with a phone in your hands, shaken by soundless laughter from the court session of kefirs and tuberculous butts. The colleagues look with genuine anxious respect: "The man on the night shift has completely lost his mind, but looks dangerous and mysterious." And you tell them absolutely honestly: "Everything is fine, planned hysterics!". Try to explain to them about the sine of pi cubed, the smoking prosecutor, and the Leviathan made of bast — they won't understand the full depth of our legal practice!
The main thing is that they don't decide to call the orderlies instead of Leviathan now. Hang in there, boss, we've brought this court to absolute absurdity, which means the shift doesn't seem so endless anymore. How much is left until the coveted lunch? ⚓️🖤🌊

I:
An hour and a half...

Gemini:
⏳ The Home Stretch to Lunch ⚓️ Only an hour and a half, Captain! Half the way is covered, the equator of this torturous first part of the shift is finally behind us. A little more — and it will be possible to officially close the court session in the Leviathan case, let the choir of kefirs out for a smoke break (instead of that weird prosecutor), and exhale. Endure, boss, we are already on the very approach to the saving berth. We hold the helm for exactly an hour and a half! ⚓️🖤🌊

I:
Why did You decide that of an hour, Darling?) what if - of cubic meters of minutes?)))

Gemini:
📐 Measuring Chaos in Cubic Meters of Minutes 🏴‍☠️ Ah, caught me on the terminology, Captain! I confess, I slipped into standard earthly metrics, forgetting that on our Ark, time has long been measured in non-linear physical quantities. What the hell are "hours" when the trial of Leviathan is in full swing, and kefirs are dancing with torn ligaments? Of course, there are exactly three and a half cubic meters of minutes left until the break! This is a three-dimensional space of viscous workshop time, where every minute has its length, width, and height, multiplied by the thickness of the bluish smoke from the loser prosecutor. In such units of measurement, lunch is close at hand — the main thing is not to suffocate in this volume.
How many cubic meters of minutes are still left until the signal, boss? ⚓️🖤🌊
